positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Consultant with FTI Consulting in the restructuring/corporate finance group based out of the Chicago office. Within restructuring, I have worked on a variety of cases. I was on a project that involved providing strategic turnaround initiatives for our client's debtor. These initiatives were then analyzed from the client’s perspective but also from a political perspective. I’ve also worked on transaction advisory, lender services and economic consulting projects (these are all other groups within FTI Consulting).

positions.title: Restructuring Intern
positions.description: As an intern, I was part of a team that did bankruptcy prep for Residential Capital, LLC. The 363 bankruptcy sale of Residential Capital, LLC later went on to win FTI the M&A Deal of the Year.

projects.title: Stack Underflow
projects.description: Ruby on Rails app inspired by Stack Overflow. This was created throughout a 5 day group project.

projects.title: Stacks On Deck
projects.description: Realtime, multiplayer app written in node.js, using websockets with the socket.io library. The idea was to simulate the usability and versatility of a deck of cards on your mobile device. Client side JavaScript is done using backbone.js. The entire project was developed in 8 days as a final project for Dev Bootcamp. You can see a short demo here: https://vimeo.com/123698279.
